title: Paragraphs -- Example 1

illustrates.quote: Guiding principles: Paragraphs must be easily identifiable and easily found with the fingers (when tracking the left-hand margin of a page).

blocks.features: Prose statement of the recommended general-reader paragraph format: paragraphs commence in cell 3, runovers start in cell 1. No print passage or braille rendering is given.

braille.notes: No worked print or braille excerpt is given for this item; it is a one-sentence prose statement of the paragraph margin convention.

resolution: Both runs agree: prose-only, no braille. status: no-braille.
